units.source_text: 但是，他从这太阳的波光中回想起来的，

en.t: But what he recalled from the sunlight shimmering on the waves
was not bamboo in a Japanese painting,

units.source_text: 而是印象派油画中的青翠树林和平静的海，是一幅洒满点点光斑的林子和海面的画。

en.t: but the vivid green woods and calm sea of an Impressionist oil painting, a picture of woods and water scattered with flecks of light.
